summary.text: Beau Baird is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 44, assumed office on November 7, 2018, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Kelsey Kauffman (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Beau Baird graduated from Greencastle High School before attending the Krannert School of Management and Purdue University.

His work experience includes managing the budget for Home Care Plus and owning and operating Baird Ranch, and he has served on the International Board of Directors of the American Quarter Horse Association, the board of the Indiana Quarter Horse Association, and Quarter Horse Racing of Indiana.
Baird succeeded Jim Baird (R) in District 44.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the House Environmental Affairs Committee and a member of the Agriculture and Rural Development and Rules and Legislative Procedures committees.
